notes.method_hc: Rarity haircuts are DISCOUNT fractions (not keep factors). Apply GradeA×(1−disc) before pool avg. Defaults: MUR/SAR/sup_SAR/FUR 10%; SR(poke/goods) 25%; SSR and S (復刻) 20% (×0.80); AR/UR/ACE 50%; MA 25%; BWR 0%. UI sliders show discount % (同 Gem／Ask 折扣). Sticky metrics are live-calc, not frozen snapshot.
notes.method_psa: Grade SAR/MUR/SR (poke_sr/goods_sr/sup_SAR) when ≥3 grade-pool cards have psa10_ask+gem_rate; else sticky A+PSA/A+CGC show — (缺資料), gem/ask 無作用. When data exists: gem_eff=gem×(1−gemDisc); ask_eff=PSA10×(1−askDisc); gem_eff×(ask_eff−fee)+(1−gem_eff)×fallback; fallback=max(0,PSA9×(1−askDisc)−fee) else HC raw no fee. Fee=US$60×fx. Defaults gemDisc 20% askDisc 10% (= old askMult 0.9). AR/MA/UR/BWR/ACE/S/SSR/FUR stay HC raw (FUR haircut 10%).
notes.sv_hot_ar: SV11B/W AR Grade A filled 2026-10-07; EV includes AR×4×0.50. Live haircut defaults now SAR 10% / BWR 0% (batch notes previously used SAR×1.0).
notes.sv_batch3: SV4a/SV3/SV7a/SV1a/SV1S Grade-A EV filled 2026-10-07; live haircut defaults SAR 10% (batch notes previously SAR×1.0).
notes.sv8a: Rates Pokegto-aligned: SAR 1.0, sup_SAR 0.1, poke_sr 0.2, UR 0.06. Master Ball mirror (~50%/box) and ACE SPEC (~1/box) omitted — no SNKR Grade A MB inventory in snapshot; do not invent prices. Equal-within-pool SAR avg (~¥4889) concentrated by Umbreon ¥46k. Landed shrink ¥18990 (4個 unit ¥17499.75) verified vs SNKR multi-qty. HC live uses SAR 10% disc (snapshot historically 0% → ¥5314).
notes.m6a: M6a 30th CELEBRATION (TC: M6aF). Pokegto ~720BOX: AR×4, 復刻S×2, SAR×1, FUR≈1/6. No PSA/CGC yet (set too new). FUR haircut default 10%.
notes.pc_box_avg: Booster-box PriceCharting ungraded/loose avg stored as pc_avg_usd (internal). UI no longer displays PC HKD average; sticky shows PriceCharting + SNKRDUNK shrink hyperlinks. HK$ override slider/input (default SNKR shrink landed) replaces landed.shrink yen for EV÷L. Never invent: missing scrape → blank PC link still allowed if URL known.
notes.snkrdunk_links: snkrdunk_shrink_url = clean EN product page for shrink/sealed box only; user can switch pack / no-shrink on SNKR site. No query params.
notes.method_sr_ar_price: SR (poke_sr/goods_sr) and AR EV inputs use min(PriceCharting ungraded USD×7.80×20.3, SNKRDUNK Grade A ¥) when both exist. PC is completed-sale ungraded (loose), not an ask. Missing source → keep the other; never invent. Archetype: SV8 スコヴィランex SR #120 SNKR Grade A ¥1000 vs PC ungraded $2.27 (~¥360). Higher rarities (SAR/MUR/MA/FUR/UR/BWR/…) stay SNKR Grade A; large PC vs SNKR gaps are flagged in notes.sar_pc_gap, not auto-minned.
notes.method_pity: Set-specific community box floors + exclusive 超配 (not official TPC). MEGA regular: AR×3, goods/item SR×1, plus one exclusive chase slot (poke_sr OR SAR OR MUR) with ~10% 3枚箱 extra. SV regular: AR×3 + one exclusive SR/SAR/UR slot (~10% 2枚箱). M2a: AR×3 + goods SR×1 + MA×1 + 0–1 extra (poke_sr~10% / SAR~37% / MUR~1.75%) — poke_sr is NOT a 2-SR floor. SV11: AR×4 + one exclusive SR/SAR/BWR slot (BWR ~1/20). Equal-within-pool averages unchanged (chase concentration e.g. Umbreon can bias). Sources: Pokegto, pokeka-atari, axstex, PokeGuardian.
notes.method_denom: Unchanged: HK-landed sealed box = SNKR 3–4 box unit ×1.035 + ship (HK$173/4 × ¥20.3). Not SNKR single-pack floor. Duties/taxes excluded. UI HKD override still beats denom.
notes.sar_pc_gap: SAR/MUR/MA/FUR not auto-minned. Large PC vs SNKR Grade A (ratio >2 or <0.5) count=11; see tools output / PR. Policy remains SNKR Grade A.
notes.pc_sr_ar_coverage: SR/AR min applied on 573 cards; PC-only 10; SNKR-only (no PC) 10; rejected SNKR typos [('SV7a', 83, 'カキツバタ SR', 111111)].
